2026_015_el_pd.paragraph: EL Education's Scope of Services Proposal to Troy School District sets out curriculum implementation professional development for an FY27 pilot of the EL Education 6-8 Language Arts curriculum. The package bundles strategic planning, a teacher pilot launch held as half days on August 19th and October 30th, virtual office hours, four in-person coaching days covering the four middle schools piloting the curriculum, and two virtual school-based coaching days. Every element except the teacher pilot launch is offered gratis, with foregone values shown as $6,000, $13,200, and $6,000. The proposal's stated Total Price is $5,000.
2026_015_el_pd.page:
**Provider and framing**

EL Education, described in the proposal as a leading K-12 education non-profit working to set a higher bar of achievement for America's public schools, offers multi-year partnerships to districts implementing its curriculum. Its portfolio includes a rigorous, intensive K-8 curriculum, classroom-tested teacher resources, professional learning, strategic planning, and coaching focused on leaders and teachers, aimed at meeting the higher bar of national standards, deepening student engagement, and transforming teaching and learning.

**Document title**

DISTRICT IMPLEMENTATION: Curriculum Implementation Professional Development Scope of Services Proposal FY27 Pilot.

**Services and pricing**

| Service | Detail | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Strategic Planning | 2 days, facilitated in 60-90-minute collaborative planning sessions with the District Leadership Team; in-person meetings plus weekly phone/virtual touchpoints | gratis ($6,000 priced) |
| EL Education 6-8 Language Arts Curriculum: Teacher Pilot Launch | August 19th: 1/2 Day; October 30th: 1/2 Day | $5,000 (in person) |
| Virtual Office Hours w/Teachers + Coaches (Zoom Link) | 4-6 sessions scheduled around middle school schedules; a "Troy School District" landing page of resources | Gratis |
| 4 Coaching Days during Pilot | 1 day at each of the 4 Middle Schools piloting; in person | Gratis ($13,200 priced) |
| Virtual School-Based Coaching Days | 2 days, which can be broken down into 12 hours of support | Gratis ($6,000 priced) |
| **Total Price** | | **$5,000** |

**Delivery details**

Strategic planning sessions are customized, occur with expert EL Education staff members and school/district leadership teams, inform the design of the partnership plan, and occur at critical points in the year to monitor progress on implementation goals and adjust the plan for clarity and alignment with school/district needs.

The teacher pilot launch gives essential learning for those planning to implement the 6-8 ELA curriculum. Through virtual or in-person sessions, participants will describe the structure, design, and key features of the curriculum; identify specific ways it is designed to close the literacy achievement gap; analyze its components to begin planning for instruction; and plan to implement specific instructional practices and strategies that meet the needs of all learners (High Leverage Instructional Practices).

Virtual Office Hours provide structure and consistency, pairing a small professional learning segment with teacher questions. They are to be scheduled when teachers can be paid a stipend to stay after school and no substitute is needed.

During the in-person coaching days, teachers teach a half day and are then released for feedback, action steps, and PD for a half day. EL coaches work with school-based instructional leadership, the implementation team, and teachers on professional learning plans, professional learning development, data analysis, and other implementation supports, guiding partners through strategic planning and goal setting and progress monitoring using the Qualtrics data platform.

The virtual school-based coaching days are delivered to individual schools and designed in alignment with each school's goals and data; the EL Education coach supports building level leaders with data collection and analysis, observes teachers and conducts feedback conversations, and leads grade level planning sessions, with building leaders scheduling the delivery.
2026_015_el_pd.verbose:
**Nature of the item**

A Scope of Services Proposal from EL Education presented to the Troy School District Board of Education for its May 19, 2026 meeting. The proposal is headed DISTRICT IMPLEMENTATION: Curriculum Implementation Professional Development Scope of Services Proposal FY27 Pilot, and it prices the professional development wrapper around a pilot of the EL Education 6-8 Language Arts curriculum in the district's middle schools.

**Provider description**

EL Education is characterized as a leading K-12 education non-profit at the forefront of an ambitious movement to set a higher bar of achievement for America's public schools. Through multi-year partnerships, EL Education provides school districts implementing its curriculum with a coordinated set of resources and support intended to ensure sustained implementation and results. Developed from its work with schools, the portfolio of resources includes a rigorous, intensive K-8 curriculum, classroom-tested teacher resources, and practical, inspiring professional learning, strategic planning, and coaching that focus on leaders and teachers. The portfolio of professional services for districts focuses on meeting the higher bar of national standards, deepening student engagement, and transforming teaching and learning to lead to high student achievement.

**Line item 1 - Strategic Planning**

Two days, facilitated in 60-90-minute collaborative planning sessions with the District Leadership Team. The planning sessions are customized and occur with expert EL Education staff members and school/district leadership teams. Sessions inform the design of the partnership plan and occur at critical points in the year to monitor progress on implementation goals and adjust the plan to ensure clarity and alignment with school/district needs. The meetings are a combination of in-person meetings along with weekly phone/virtual touchpoints. Price: gratis ($6,000 priced).

**Line item 2 - EL Education 6-8 Language Arts Curriculum: Teacher Pilot Launch**

Scheduled as August 19th: 1/2 Day and October 30th: 1/2 Day. This comprehensive professional development offering provides essential learning for those planning to implement the 6-8 ELA curriculum. Participants will gain an understanding of the principles behind the curriculum, explain the structure, explore specific ways the curriculum meets all students' needs, and begin planning for instruction. Via engagement in a series of virtual or in-person sessions, participants will be able to: describe the structure, design, and key features of the curriculum; identify specific ways the curriculum is designed to close the literacy achievement gap; analyze the components of the curriculum to begin planning for instruction; and plan to implement specific instructional practices and strategies that meet the needs of all learners (High Leverage Instructional Practices). Price: $5,000 (in person).

**Line item 3 - Virtual Office Hours w/Teachers + Coaches**

Delivered by Zoom link. Virtual Office Hours provide a structure and consistency in which EL Education shares a small professional learning segment and answers questions for teachers. The proposal contemplates setting up 4-6 Virtual Office Hours to occur when best for the dynamic school schedules at the Middle Schools, on days when teachers can be paid a stipend to stay after but do not need a substitute. EL Education will also set up a "Troy School District" landing page for teachers with links to resources, videos, and supports for the curriculum. Price: Gratis.

**Line item 4 - 4 Coaching Days during Pilot**

One day at each of the 4 Middle Schools piloting during the pilot, delivered in person, to support teachers. Teachers will be teaching a half day and then released for feedback, action steps, and PD for a half day. During coaching sessions, EL coaches work with the school-based instructional leadership, implementation team, and teachers to support professional learning plans, professional learning development, data analysis, and additional components of curriculum implementation support. EL coaches guide partners through strategic planning and goal setting and progress monitoring using the Qualtrics data platform, and build the capacity of school-based leadership, teacher leaders, and teachers. Price: Gratis ($13,200 priced).

**Line item 5 - Virtual School-Based Coaching Days**

Two days, which can be broken down into 12 hours of support, delivered virtually, and usable for office hours, planning sessions, or as needed for the schools. These coaching days, delivered to individual schools in the district, will be designed in alignment with the individual school's goals and data. The EL Education coach will support building level leaders with data collection and analysis, observe teachers and conduct feedback conversations, and lead grade level planning sessions. The building leaders will work collaboratively with the EL Education coach to schedule these days for the delivery of ongoing coaching support. Price: Gratis ($6,000 priced).

**Pricing summary**

| Service | Price |
| --- | --- |
| Strategic Planning (2 days) | gratis ($6,000 priced) |
| Teacher Pilot Launch (Aug 19, Oct 30 half days) | $5,000 (in person) |
| Virtual Office Hours w/Teachers + Coaches | Gratis |
| 4 Coaching Days during Pilot | Gratis ($13,200 priced) |
| Virtual School-Based Coaching Days (2 days / 12 hours) | Gratis ($6,000 priced) |
| Total Price | $5,000 |

**Observations**

The only charged component is the in-person teacher pilot launch, and the Total Price line matches that single charge at $5,000. Three of the five services carry a stated priced value that EL Education is waiving, so the proposal documents substantial support offered at no cost alongside the billed launch. The proposal is paginated 1 through 4 and names no signatory, contract term, or purchase order number.

2026_017_8_a_bp_7_boulan_middle_school_a.paragraph: Barton Malow Builders project manager Josh Eisenman wrote to Troy School District Assistant Superintendent of Business Services Dan Trudel on 4/22/2026 recommending award of three remaining bid categories on the BP#7 Boulan Middle School Renovation: Overhead Doors to Overhead Inc. at $97,000, Terrazzo to Marble Life at $54,212, and Acoustic Spray Installation to D9 of Stony Creek Services, Inc. at $119,518. Total contractor cost is stated as $270,730, contingency (10%) as $27,073, and total construction cost as $297,803.
